payload.title: feat/cross-goal-moves-and-status at fe621cb: no move crosses Goals, status per Goal (step 3)
payload.body: Commit fe621cb on branch feat/cross-goal-moves-and-status, from 53246b6. A refer, aim, close or apply whose key leads to another Goal is refused (spec rule 32); a test holds the move tables and OWED in agreement in a two-Goal store, naming the two asymmetries; hyp status with a Goal id prints one Goal, and a store with many Goals prints a GOALS table and one AWAITING OWNER list; the last checkpoint is per Goal and the runner's. Code and tests were written, and go test run, while building, before E's rule; the rule's checks run after it.
